Def.label: on health condition
Def.description: Invoked when a health condition has been added.

Def.label: threat appeared
Def.description: Invoked for all pawns when a threat appears on the map.

Def.label: threat cleared
Def.description: Invoked for all pawns when all threats are cleared from the map.

Def.label: new job started
Def.description: Invoked when the pawn begins a new job.

Def.label: schedule changed
Def.description: Invoked when a colonist's current timetable assignment changes, at an hour boundary or when SetAssignment edits the active schedule. Consecutive hours with the same assignment do not trigger it.
